reply_text: The deadline is 15 May. I've replied to Pree in our DM to say so. On 14 October she told me in that same DM that her cutoff for the Marrow Agrisupply paperwork on the Greywater renewal is now 15 May. I found no contract or other file in the share that gives a different date, and I asked her to tell me if it has changed since. The date came from her own DM, so it went only back to her.
